title: Terms & Conditions
description: Understand the terms that govern your use of Busaty’s platform and applications.

hero.title: Terms & Conditions
hero.subtitle: By accessing Busaty you agree to follow the policies outlined below.

sections.heading: 1. Definitions
sections.body: "Services" refers to the Busaty platform and applications. A "user" is any guardian, supervisor, or school representative who creates an account or uses the platform.

sections.heading: 2. User obligations
sections.body: Users must provide accurate information, keep credentials safe, and avoid sharing unlawful or abusive content.

sections.heading: 3. Data privacy
sections.body: We protect student and guardian data and only share it with third parties when consent is granted or when required by law.

sections.heading: 4. Liability limits
sections.body: Busaty is not liable for damages caused by misuse of the app or outages beyond our control, although we aim to resolve issues quickly.

sections.heading: 5. Updates
sections.body: We may adjust these terms from time to time and will publish the latest version here with an updated timestamp.
